articles.title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
articles.preview: Alphabet’s latest earnings report revealed a significant miss, primarily driven by a slowdown in search revenue. Simultaneously, the company is investing heavily in AI, particularly through its Gemini model.

summary.t: Alphabet’s search and other segment revenue grew by 12% to approximately $63 billion, falling short of analyst expectations for the second consecutive quarter. Despite robust search query growth – the strongest in five years – the gap between usage and revenue is widening due to increased use of AI bots and agents. The company attributes this deceleration largely to unfavorable foreign exchange rates, which are expected to worsen in the fourth quarter.

Alphabet is aggressively investing in AI infrastructure and services, driven by demand from consumers and businesses. The company’s Gemini model is competing with offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic, and its Gemini-powered enterprise services are gaining traction. They’ve recently made significant updates to product listing ads, incorporating AI capabilities, and advertisers are rapidly adopting AI tools, generating over 1.5 billion campaign assets in the third quarter.

summary.h: Cloud Business Growth as a Counterbalance
summary.t: While search faces headwinds, Alphabet’s cloud business is experiencing substantial growth, more than doubling to nearly $31 billion in the second quarter. The cloud backlog reached approximately $560 billion, reflecting strong demand for AI infrastructure. Management anticipates recognizing over half of this backlog within the next 24 months.
The company’s free cash flow turned negative for the first time in its history at $5.9 billion.

articles.title: KI-Investitionen tragen nicht überall Früchte
articles.preview: Die Investitionen der Tech-Giganten in künstliche Intelligenz zeigen gemischte Ergebnisse. Microsoft erzielt positive Ergebnisse, während Alphabet mit hohen Kosten kämpft und seinen Börsenwert deutlich verliert.

summary.t: Microsoft verzeichnete einen Free Cash Flow von 18,6 Milliarden Dollar, was über den Erwartungen lag. Das Wachstum der Cloud-Sparte Azure beschleunigte sich auf 48 Prozent. Finanzchefin Amy Hood bezeichnete das Quartal als erfolgreich. Die Investitionen blieben mit 45,2 Milliarden Dollar hinter den Planungen zurück, hauptsächlich aufgrund von Lieferverzögerungen.

Alphabet, die Muttergesellschaft von Google, sah sich mit hohen Investitionen in KI-Infrastruktur konfrontiert. Der Umsatz stieg zwar um 20 Prozent, der Free Cash Flow verdoppelte sich fast und überstieg die Prognosen um das 250-fache. Die Werbeeinnahmen enttäuschten ebenfalls.

Analyst Jesse Cohen wies auf eine Verschiebung im Geschäftsmodell von Microsoft hin. Die zunehmende Nutzung von digitalen Assistenten und nutzungsbasierte Abrechnungen verringern die Bedeutung von Lizenzeinnahmen. Microsoft reagiert mit günstigeren KI-Modellen.

articles.title: Quartalszahlen der Tech-Riesen: Zwei Seiten der KI-Medaille: Google zahlt, Microsoft kassiert
articles.preview: Zwei Tech-Riesen zeigen gegensätzliche Ergebnisse im KI-Boom. Google investiert stark, während Microsoft beeindruckende Gewinne erzielt.

summary.t: Microsoft erzielte einen Free Cash Flow von 18,6 Milliarden Dollar, was die Erwartungen deutlich übertraf. Die Cloud-Sparte Azure wuchs um 48 Prozent, was Analysten positiv überraschte. Finanzchefin Amy Hood bezeichnete das Quartal als einen erfolgreichen Start ins Geschäftsjahr 2026/2027.

Alphabet sah sich mit einem starken Einbruch der Aktie von über 10 Prozent und einem Verlust von über 400 Milliarden Dollar konfrontiert. Die Investitionen in Rechenzentren überstiegen die Einnahmen, während Google Cloud einen hohen negativen Free Cash Flow verzeichnete.

Experte Marcel Tietjen wies auf eine Verschiebung im Geschäftsmodell von Microsoft hin, die durch den Aufstieg von digitalen Assistenten und nutzungsbasierte KI-Modelle verstärkt wird. Das Wachstum von Microsoft wird weniger von der Nutzerzahl, sondern vom Einsatz von KI-Agenten in Unternehmen abhängen.

Anleger beobachten die steigenden Kosten für KI-Infrastruktur mit Besorgnis und befürchten massive Abschreibungen. Die Prämien für die Absicherung gegen Zahlungsausfälle der Tech-Konzerne sind auf Rekordhöhen gestiegen.

articles.title: KI-Boom gibt Rückenwind: Microsoft legt makellose Zahlen vor
articles.preview: Microsoft hat im letzten Quartal außergewöhnlich gute Geschäftszahlen vorgelegt, was zu einem deutlichen Kursanstieg der Aktie führte. Die Investitionen in Künstliche Intelligenz zahlen sich offenbar deutlich aus.

summary.t: Microsoft verzeichnete im vergangenen Quartal einen Umsatz von 92,3 Milliarden Dollar, was einer Steigerung von 19 Prozent entspricht. Besonders hervorzuheben ist das starke Wachstum der Cloud-Sparte Azure, die um 48 Prozent auf 33,17 Milliarden Dollar an Umsatz zulegte.
Der operative Gewinn stieg um rund 20 Prozent auf 45,9 Milliarden Dollar, während das Nettoergebnis auf 4,89 Dollar pro Aktie anstieg.

articles.title: Anthropic’s public benefit structure creates unusual risks for IPO investors
articles.preview: Anthropic, an AI lab, is planning a highly anticipated IPO with a potential valuation of over $1.5 trillion. However, the company’s unique public benefit corporation structure introduces significant risks for investors.

summary.t: Anthropic is pursuing an IPO as a public benefit corporation (PBC), a structure designed to balance profit with a stated public benefit. Other companies like Warby Parker and Patagonia operate under similar structures. Anthropic’s S-1 filing outlines its goal of “responsibly developing and maintaining advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity.”

The company’s governance is notably concentrated, with seven co-founders holding significant voting power, including Dario Amodei, who controls 50.1% of the voting rights. This structure gives the board of directors considerable latitude to balance shareholder interests with the company’s mission. Legal experts note the ambiguity surrounding the PBC’s ‘balance’ requirement, making it difficult to determine priority between profit and public benefit.

Anthropic has taken measures to control its AI development, restricting access to potentially dangerous models. This practice could continue, potentially impacting revenue and profit growth. The company is focused on AI safety, highlighting numerous risks in its IPO filing.
Analysts emphasize the importance of investors understanding Anthropic’s PBC structure.

articles.title: Google alters its cloud playbook, enlisting partners to sell more AI chips
articles.preview: Google is shifting its cloud strategy by partnering with other companies to sell its AI chips. This move aims to increase market reach and compete with Nvidia’s dominance in the artificial intelligence chip market.

summary.t: Google is allowing customers to access its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) for the first time outside of its own cloud infrastructure. This partnership with Oracle marks a significant change in Google’s approach, driven by cloud boss Thomas Kurian’s prior experience at Oracle. Analysts predict a substantial increase in Google Cloud revenue, with growth potentially surpassing 90% year-over-year.

Estimates of TPU sales vary, but projections indicate substantial growth. TD Cowen forecasts $9.4 billion in sales for the second half of 2023 and $62.5 billion by 2027. Wells Fargo anticipates approximately $9 billion in third-quarter sales and $99 billion in 2024, highlighting the potential scale of this new business venture.

Google’s strategy is designed to challenge Nvidia’s market leadership. The company’s latest Ironwood TPU is estimated to be 44% less expensive to own and operate than an Nvidia GB200 server, according to SemiAnalysis. This shift is fueled by Google’s own AI servers paying for themselves within two years.

articles.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
articles.preview: OpenAI and ServiceNow are deepening their collaboration. This expansion will integrate OpenAI's AI models into ServiceNow’s platform and vice versa.

articles.title: Investors brace for a hawkish hold and tech on tap
articles.preview: Investors are anticipating a steady interest rate hold from the Federal Reserve and a significant wave of tech earnings reports. Major financial results are emerging alongside geopolitical developments and a unique political pledge.

summary.t: The Federal Reserve is expected to maintain its current interest rates at 2pm ET. Policymakers are citing rising prices, fueled by AI demand and energy costs, as the reason for this cautious approach. Futures markets remain stable as investors await the official announcement.

Several companies delivered impressive financial results. UBS reported a near 30% increase in pretax profit, while Deutsche Bank achieved record profits with $2.2 trillion in assets under management. Notably, Jio Platforms experienced a surge in trading, raising $3.2 billion in India’s largest IPO.

articles.title: The future of the firm
articles.preview: Artificial intelligence is poised to reshape organizational structures. It will likely integrate into existing roles, alongside and between human employees.

articles.title: Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work
articles.preview: Legora is developing a new operating system designed for legal professionals. The system leverages AI models to streamline legal workflows and improve efficiency.

articles.title: Anthropic's IPO is risky business
articles.preview: Anthropic’s upcoming IPO reveals significant risks associated with developing advanced AI, particularly concerning potential harm and market pressures. The prospectus highlights several unprecedented challenges facing the company as it seeks to become a major player in the artificial intelligence industry.

summary.t: Anthropic’s IPO prospectus details over 90 pages of risk factors, exceeding typical corporate disclosures. The company identifies potential dangers ranging from existential threats to humanity to a current dispute with the Trump administration. A key concern is the possibility of its AI models causing ‘catastrophic or existential risks.’

Anthropic faces considerable operational hurdles, including fierce competition and the difficulty of ensuring AI safety. The company’s reliance on expanding data centers is also a major risk, with 16 states considering moratoriums on data center development. Furthermore, the availability of sufficient electrical power, particularly with rising demand, presents a significant challenge.
Anthropic acknowledges potential legal issues, mirroring concerns raised against rivals like OpenAI and Meta.

articles.title: Wall Street schließt im Plus : US-Anleger setzen wieder auf KI
articles.preview: Die Wall Street erlebte am Dienstag einen positiven Schluss, getrieben von der Hoffnung auf einen KI-Boom. Halbleiterwerte erlebten einen deutlichen Aufwärtstrend.

summary.t: Der Dow-Jones Index schloss bei 52.378 Punkten kaum verändert. Der S&P 500 stieg um 0,6 Prozent auf 7723 Punkte. Der Nasdaq Index gewann 1,2 Prozent auf 26.478 Punkte.
Der bevorstehende Börsengang von Anthropic sorgte für eine Erholung bei Halbleiterwerten. Der Branchenindex stieg drei Tage in Folge.

articles.title: Chart: Anthropic's cash pile towers over nearly every U.S. company
articles.preview: Anthropic, an AI lab, holds a massive cash reserve exceeding nearly every U.S. company. This unprecedented financial position is largely due to significant fundraising efforts over the past six years.

summary.t: As of June 30th, Anthropic reported $112.4 billion in cash and $19.3 billion in short-term investments, totaling $131.7 billion. This figure surpasses all non-bank U.S. companies except Berkshire Hathaway and Alphabet.

Depending on the success of its upcoming initial public offering, Anthropic’s cash could rise to over $230 billion. The company anticipates that existing investors will also participate in the IPO, potentially reducing the funds it collects.

articles.title: AI debt fears ease ahead of Oracle, Alphabet and Amazon updates. Here's what to watch.
articles.preview: AI debt concerns have lessened recently, but new tests are expected. Several major tech companies, including Oracle, Alphabet, and Amazon, will be reporting their quarterly results this week, which could impact credit markets.

summary.h: Recent Easing of AI Debt Fears
summary.t: Following a period of volatility, concerns regarding artificial intelligence debt have decreased somewhat. Investor confidence is returning, particularly after Meta Platforms announced its $95 billion stock offering, which reduced its credit-default swap spreads. These spreads had previously risen due to Meta’s negative free cash flow. CNBC contributor Paul Meeks believes these positive sentiments may continue as companies release their earnings.

Oracle is scheduled to hold its Investor Day on Wednesday. Alphabet and Amazon.com will report their quarterly results after the market close on Wednesday and Thursday, respectively. Analysts predict Alphabet will report free cash flow of -$2.3 billion and spend $55.2 billion on capital expenditures. Amazon is expected to report -$9.9 billion in free cash flow against capex of $58.7 billion.
Credit spreads remain wider than a year ago due to increased AI debt issuance. Meta’s CDS spread is up 177% year to date, while Amazon’s has increased by 129%.

articles.title: Walmart says AI training is boosting confidence with the technology among its 2.1 million associates
articles.preview: Walmart’s massive workforce is showing increased confidence in AI technology thanks to targeted training programs. The retailer’s survey of 2.1 million associates reveals a surprising level of excitement and comfort with AI tools.

summary.t: A survey of over 1.7 million Walmart associates revealed that 77% of office-based staff are excited about AI’s potential to improve their work. Furthermore, 84% of frontline associates expressed confidence in using digital tools, largely due to AI-powered tools they now utilize daily.
Walmart partnered with Google and OpenAI to offer free AI certification programs. Associates who completed OpenAI training experienced a 27% confidence gain when using AI.

Walmart’s approach focuses on using AI to reduce friction and enhance human capabilities. Automation efforts have created new roles, such as quality assurance positions, rather than causing widespread job losses.

articles.title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
articles.preview: Retell is leveraging OpenAI models to handle 100 million monthly calls. The company has achieved a significant revenue run rate thanks to its use of Codex.

articles.title: Alphabet falls 10% in premarket, putting it on course for its biggest ever post-earnings drop
articles.preview: Alphabet experienced a significant stock drop in premarket trading following its third-quarter earnings report. This decline marks the company’s largest post-earnings fall in its history.

summary.t: Microsoft’s shares rose nearly 4% in premarket trading, driven by strong capital expenditure figures of $45.2 billion – 30% higher than the previous year. Despite this, analysts’ projections of $50.67 billion were exceeded.

Alphabet’s stock plummeted 10% in premarket trading, setting a record for its worst post-earnings reaction since its 2004 IPO. The company reported negative free cash flow of $9.07 billion, significantly lower than anticipated.

articles.title: Der Börsen-Tag: Samsung Electronics trotz Rekordgewinn unter Druck
articles.preview: Die Aktienmärkte in Asien zeigen eine gemischte Performance, während Samsung Electronics unter Druck steht. Trotz eines Rekordgewinns gibt es Unsicherheiten über die Zukunft des Unternehmens.

summary.t: Die Aktienmärkte in Ostasien und Australien zeigten eine unruhige Stimmung. Alphabet verzeichnete einen deutlichen Kursverlust, während Samsung Electronics um 5,0 Prozent fiel, obwohl das Unternehmen einen Rekordgewinn für das dritte Quartal bekannt gab. Die Verfehlung der Gewinnerwartungen im Halbleiterbereich trug ebenfalls zur Belastung bei.

Die US-Notenbank hat den Leitzins unverändert gelassen und betonte die Notwendigkeit weiterer Informationen zur Festlegung der Geldpolitik. Die Wirtschaft wächst weiterhin mit einem starken Tempo, während Microsoft ein beschleunigtes Wachstum im Cloud-Geschäft verzeichnete und einen hohen Cashflow meldete. Die Investitionsausgaben für Halbleiter werden auf 76,8 Milliarden Won prognostiziert.

articles.title: Samsung Electronics shares slid despite record profit in the third-quarter
articles.preview: Samsung Electronics experienced a significant stock drop despite reporting record-breaking profits. The company announced a massive shareholder return plan, fueled by strong chip demand.

summary.t: Samsung Electronics reported a 126.88% year-on-year increase in revenue, reaching 13.85% growth from the previous quarter. Operating profit rose dramatically, increasing 783.11% compared to the prior year. The company achieved a record quarterly operating profit of 100 trillion won, marking a fourth consecutive record quarter.

Samsung announced a 30 trillion won dividend payout for the third quarter, equivalent to 4,601 won per share. The company intends to return 55 to 75 trillion won to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks, with a final plan set for late January 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat
articles.preview: Microsoft’s stock jumped 4% following strong earnings, driven by significant growth in its cloud business. The company’s revenue exceeded expectations, signaling continued success in its strategic investments.

summary.t: Microsoft’s stock rose sharply after reporting a 19% year-over-year revenue increase. A key driver was the 48% growth in its Azure cloud infrastructure business, now its largest single business. Capital expenditures reached $45.2 billion, a 30% increase from the prior year. Microsoft anticipates 49% to 50% growth in Azure for the next quarter.

The company is investing heavily in data center infrastructure to meet growing AI demand. Approximately 75% of capital expenditures are now focused on short-lived assets like Intel chips and Nvidia GPUs. Microsoft plans to spend over $50 billion in capital expenditures and finance leases for the fiscal second quarter, exceeding StreetAccount’s consensus.

Free cash flow declined 27% to $18.63 billion. Microsoft intends to maintain free cash flow generation through 2027, potentially utilizing debt markets and other funding sources. The company’s net income increased to $36.63 billion.

articles.title: CoreWeave and other neocloud stocks drop after Microsoft capex comes in below expectations
articles.preview: Shares of neocloud companies, including CoreWeave and Nebius, have fallen sharply following Microsoft’s lower-than-expected capital expenditure report. This decline reflects concerns about delays in data center capacity delivery from infrastructure partners.

summary.t: Microsoft reported capital expenditures of $45.2 billion, which was 30% higher than the previous year but below analyst estimates of $50.7 billion. The company attributed this difference to timing issues and a shift in finance leases, alongside significantly higher Azure revenue growth of 48%.
Following Microsoft’s announcement, shares of neocloud companies like CoreWeave and Nebius dropped by nearly 5%. Additionally, IREN fell approximately 3%.

articles.title: As Waymo expands overseas, it remains a niche cash-burning business
articles.preview: Waymo’s international expansion is underway, but the company continues to operate at a significant loss. Despite revenue growth, Waymo’s operations are still heavily reliant on Alphabet’s investment.

summary.t: Waymo generated $372 million in revenue during the third quarter, representing an 8% increase year-over-year. However, the Other Bets segment, which includes Waymo, experienced a substantial operating loss of $2.05 billion, a rise from $1.43 billion the previous year. This segment also encompasses Isomorphic’s drug design research.

Waymo is expanding its operations to three new markets: Germany, Singapore, and Spain. The company also plans to launch robotaxi rides in Canada and intends to begin operations in Germany in 2027, marking its first entry into the European Union.

articles.title: Chip-Werte gefragt: Wall Street legt nach Fed-Zinspause zu
articles.preview: Die US-Notenbank Fed hat den Leitzins unverändert gelassen, was zu einer Erhöhung im Dezember führt. Anleger konzentrieren sich verstärkt auf die Unternehmensbilanzen.

summary.t: Die US-Börsen erlebten am Mittwoch einen positiven Verlauf. Der Dow-Jones Index schloss bei 52.475 Punkten, der S&P 500 bei 7744 Zählern und der Nasdaq bei 26.550 Punkten. Die Anleger reagierten positiv auf die erwartete Zinserhöhung im Dezember.

Die Finanzmärkte erwarten nun eine Zinserhöhung der Fed um 25 Basispunkte im Dezember mit einer Wahrscheinlichkeit von 85,0 Prozent. Dies stellt eine deutliche Erhöhung gegenüber den 78,3 Prozent vom Vortag dar.

articles.title: Jim Cramer sees major implications from SK Hynix's home-run quarter
articles.preview: Jim Cramer believes SK Hynix's strong earnings demonstrate a path for AI stocks to rally despite market skepticism. The company's surge has positively impacted other chipmakers, signaling renewed investor interest.

summary.t: SK Hynix shares rose over 13% following better-than-expected earnings. The company’s revenue exceeded estimates by approximately 6%, with gross margins at 85.7%.
Micron increased by almost 6%, Arm rose by 4%, and AMD climbed by 3%. This rally followed SK Hynix’s successful results.

SK Hynix’s low valuation, at four times 2027 earnings, played a crucial role. The company projected shipment growth in the mid-20% range and indicated full production through 2029, supported by long-term customer agreements.

articles.title: Chipotle shares rise 7% after CEO says same-store sales growth will continue
articles.preview: Chipotle’s stock rose significantly following the CEO’s optimistic outlook. Despite some operational challenges, the company reported continued same-store sales growth driven by changing consumer behavior.

summary.t: Chipotle reported a net income of $339.9 million for the third quarter, down from $382.1 million in the prior year. The restaurant-level operating margin decreased from 24.5% to 23.3%. Excluding certain charges, earnings per share were 27 cents. Net sales increased by 9.6% to $3.29 billion, largely due to the opening of new restaurants.
Same-store sales growth rose 2.1% for the quarter, supported by a 1.3% increase in average check.

articles.title: Alphabet sinks 10% as it holds 2026 capex unchanged, expects significant increase in 2027
articles.preview: Alphabet experienced a significant stock decline, dropping over 10%, alongside disappointing financial results. The company’s continued investment in artificial intelligence is raising concerns among investors.

summary.t: Alphabet’s revenue increased by 25% year-over-year, reaching $88.69 billion. However, the company reported a net income of $26.17 billion, a decrease from $34.98 billion in the prior year. Operating income also fell short of expectations at $40.58 billion.

summary.h: Cash Flow and Capital Expenditure Concerns
summary.t: The company experienced negative free cash flow of $9.07 billion, significantly below analyst estimates of $2.70 billion. Alphabet’s capital expenditures totaled $51.36 billion for the quarter, falling short of the $55.09 billion predicted. The company’s long-term debt increased dramatically to $125.1 billion.

articles.title: SK Hynix shares jump 11% after record quarterly profit, outperforming broader market
articles.preview: SK Hynix reported record profits, jumping 11% in Asia. The company announced a massive return to shareholders through dividends and buybacks, significantly outperforming the broader market.

summary.t: SK Hynix achieved a record quarterly profit, with revenue rising 327.9% and operating profit climbing 632.1% year-on-year. The company plans to return approximately 100 trillion won to shareholders through a combination of a 30 trillion won cash dividend and a 60 trillion won share buyback program. Additionally, they will return gains from their investment in Kioxia through a special dividend of 14 trillion won.

SK Hynix paused plans for a potential Solidigm pre-IPO fundraising and announced a revised shareholder return target of over 50% of cumulative free cash flow between 2025 and 2027. The company anticipates continued AI investment momentum and expects a structural supply-demand imbalance in the memory market to persist. They plan to significantly increase investment next year.

Shipments of HBM4, the sixth generation of high-bandwidth memory, are expected to surpass HBM3E in the fourth quarter. Average selling prices for DRAM rose by a high-20s percentage, driven by increased HBM4 sales and higher conventional DRAM prices.

articles.title: Oracle stock pops 11% as long-term revenue forecast and clarity on financing ease debt concerns
articles.preview: Oracle stock experienced a significant surge, rising 11% on Wednesday. The company’s revised long-term revenue forecast and plans to manage debt have eased investor concerns.

summary.t: Oracle announced a projected revenue of $225 billion for fiscal 2030, anticipating an average annual growth rate of 35%. This significantly exceeds the 8% growth expected by analysts polled by LSEG.

The company intends to raise no more than $20 billion in additional funding over the next three years, equally split between equity and debt. Vendor financing, customer hardware, and prepayments are expected to reduce upfront cash needs.

articles.title: Der Börsen-Tag: Etsy im Höhenflug
articles.preview: Etsy verzeichnet einen deutlichen Kursanstieg nach starken Quartalsergebnissen. Das Unternehmen übertrifft sowohl Umsatz- als auch Ergebnisprognosen.

articles.title: Jim Cramer warns investors not to get fooled by the latest AI stock rally
articles.preview: CNBC’s Jim Cramer warned that the latest rally in AI stocks doesn't mean the data center trade is out of the woods.

articles.title: GM will switch to Nasdaq from the NYSE on Nov. 17
articles.preview: General Motors is set to relocate its stock trading from the New York Stock Exchange to the Nasdaq on November 17th. This move reflects the company’s strategic shift towards a more technology-focused business model.

summary.t: General Motors announced it will move its stock trading from the New York Stock Exchange to the Nasdaq on November 17th. The company’s ticker symbol will remain ‘GM’.
This move aligns with GM’s customer-focused, technology-driven strategy. The company believes Nasdaq is a better fit as it grows.

articles.title: Amazon's anti-tokenmaxxing memo says engineers should be pickier about using AI
articles.preview: Amazon has rapidly integrated AI across the e-commerce giant's sprawling business operations under CEO Andy Jassy.

articles.title: Größter IPO Indiens: Jio Platforms startet Frontalangriff auf US-Tech-Giganten
articles.preview: Mit dem größten Börsengang der indischen Geschichte startet Jio Platforms einen Angriff auf US-Tech-Giganten. Die Nachfrage überstieg das Angebot bei Weitem, was auf ein großes Interesse an der Firma hindeutet.

summary.t: Der indische Telekommunikations- und Digitalkonzern Jio Platforms hat mit dem größten Börsengang der indischen Geschichte begonnen. Ursprünglich war die Emission für 2024 geplant, wurde aber zweimal verschoben. Der Iran-Krieg war die Hauptursache für die Verzögerung. Die Nachfrage überstieg das Angebot bei Weitem, mit einer Überzeichnung von 22-fach. Dies entsprach einer Nachfrage von über 77 Milliarden US-Dollar.

Der Börsengang wurde von einem enormen Anlegerinteresse begleitet. Das Unternehmen wurde 2016 mit dem Ziel gegründet, den fast 1,5 Milliarden Menschen in Indien einen schnellen Internetzugang zu ermöglichen. Jio zählte im Juni dieses Jahres 533 Millionen Nutzer, was etwa einem Drittel der indischen Gesamtbevölkerung entspricht.

Der Konzern wurde insgesamt mit 108,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet. Analysten sehen in der hohen Nachfrage ein Zeichen für das Vertrauen in das Unternehmen. Der IPO von Jio Platforms könnte zu einem der wichtigsten Kapitalmarktereignisse Indiens werden. Der Konzern investiert verstärkt in künstliche Intelligenz und baut eigene Rechenzentren auf.

Jio Platforms tritt nun auch als Konkurrent von Starlink an, da das Unternehmen eine eigene Sparte für Satelliten in niedriger Erdumlaufbahn betreibt. Die Regierung in Neu-Delhi hat bisher noch keine endgültige Lizenz für Satelliten-Breitbanddienste vergeben.

articles.title: 40 DAX-Aktien jetzt rund um die Uhr handelbar
articles.preview: Die Deutsche Börse erweitert den Handel mit DAX-Aktien auf rund um die Uhr. Dies ermöglicht es Investoren, Aktien von Unternehmen wie Siemens und SAP jederzeit zu kaufen und zu verkaufen.

summary.t: Ab sofort können Anleger rund um die Uhr mit den 40 DAX-Aktien handeln. Der reguläre Handel auf Xetra läuft werktags von neun Uhr morgens bis halb sechs abends. Seit Dezember vergangenen Jahres waren die Handelszeiten von acht Uhr morgens bis zehn Uhr abends erweitert.
Der Handel in der Nacht und am Wochenende erfolgt über die Handelsplattform 360X. Die Commerzbank beteiligt sich an dieser Plattform. Die Abwicklung erfolgt über Clearstream-Konten.

articles.title: Zweijährige Rally vorbei: Chinas KI-Blase ist längst geplatzt - mit harten Folgen für Kleinanleger
articles.preview: Die chinesische KI-Aktienblase ist platzt, was zu massiven Kursverlusten führt. Dieser Absturz hat erhebliche Konsequenzen für Kleinanleger und gefährdet Pekings Bemühungen um einen stabilen Aktienmarkt.

summary.t: Der chinesische Aktienmarkt, insbesondere der STAR50-Index, hat in den letzten Monaten einen dramatischen Einbruch erlebt. Innerhalb von vier Monaten fiel der Index um 40 Prozent, was einer Vernichtung von rund 480 Milliarden Dollar an Marktwert entspricht. Dieser Absturz ist deutlich stärker als in westlichen Märkten.

Die Sorgen um die Nachfrage nach KI-Technologien und die zunehmenden Beschränkungen für chinesische Exporte haben zu einer Spekulationsblase in den Bereichen künstliche Intelligenz und Halbleiter geführt. Überzogene Bewertungen, Steuerzahlungen und US-Exportverbote trugen ebenfalls zum Absturz bei.
Kleinanleger, die den chinesischen Markt stark dominierten, erleiden besonders hohe Verluste. Der Aktienkurs von Unitree, der bei Börsengang 8000-fach überzeichnet war, ist um die Hälfte gefallen.
